pages.text: The $(bold)Curse Crafting Ritual$() uses curse power itself as an ingredient, together with old-god items, to make special gear.$(br2)The structure is a $(bold)5x5x3$() multiblock with the $(bold)Gheloth Ore$() at the centre of layer 2; the next page holds a $(bold)sample structure you can Visualise$() - just copy it.$(br2)Note: the ritual shows $(bold)no text at all$() (no chat, no action bar). Compare your build with this guide instead; the first interaction after it is complete plays a $(bold)thunderclap$().

pages.name: Sample structure (5x5x3)
pages.text: Press the $(bold)Visualise$() button on this page to return to the world, aim the ghost structure at the ground and build block by block.$(br2)The pattern reads $(bold)top-down$() in three layers:$(li)$(bold)Top$(): nine seared lanterns$(li)$(bold)Middle$(): the ore in the centre, eight seared brick walls and eight soul fire blocks around it$(li)$(bold)Bottom$(): modifier worktable in the centre, obsidian / crying obsidian / soul sand around it

$(bold)Layer by layer$() (offsets from the ore; dx is east, dz is south):$(br2)$(bold)Bottom$() y = ore - 1:$(li)(0,0) $(bold)modifier worktable$()$(li)(+/-1,0) (0,+/-1) $(bold)obsidian$()$(li)(+/-1,+/-1) (+/-2,0) (0,+/-2) $(bold)crying obsidian$()$(li)(+/-1,+/-2) (+/-2,+/-1) $(bold)soul sand$()$(li)(+/-2,+/-2) the four corners are free$(br2)$(bold)Middle$() y = ore:$(li)(0,0) $(bold)Gheloth Ore$()$(li)(+/-2,0) (0,+/-2) (+/-1,+/-1) $(bold)seared brick wall$() (scorched also works)$(li)(+/-1,+/-2) (+/-2,+/-1) $(bold)soul fire$() (lit on the soul sand below)$(li)everything else (the corners and the four cells touching the ore) $(bold)must be air$()

$(bold)Top$() y = ore + 1: put one $(bold)seared lantern$() $(bold)directly on top$() of every brick wall and on top of the ore - nine lanterns in total (scorched lanterns also work).$(br2)The middle one (above the ore) is the $(bold)core slot$(): that is where the recipe's old-god item goes and where you take the product from. The other eight are $(bold)material slots$().$(br2)Right-click a material lantern while holding an item to place it (it floats one block above the lantern, has no collision and bobs like a dropped item); right-click the same lantern again to take it back. Items only ever belong to their own lantern, so an empty lantern never steals a neighbour's material.

$(bold)Starting$(): once every material is placed, hold the $(bold)core old-god item$() the recipe asks for and right-click the lantern $(bold)above the ore$().$(br2)$(bold)During the ritual$() all items gather three blocks above the ore, constantly emitting item-coloured break particles, and a $(bold)deep purple particle beam$() links you to the cluster, $(bold)draining 10 curse power per tick$() from you (first the curse core pool, then the $(l:bottle)bottle$(), then a $(l:vault)vault$(); soul energy is never used).

$(bold)Finishing$(): when the curse is fully absorbed the cluster explodes (thunder and a dragon wingbeat) and the product floats on the lantern above the ore; right-click to take it.$(br2)$(bold)Interruptions$(): not enough curse power, moving more than 16 blocks away, breaking the structure, or touching a lantern mid-ritual. On interruption you only hear an extinguish sound, every material floats back to its own lantern, and $(bold)nothing is consumed$().$(br2)Recipes live in $(bold)data/tinkersnewlife/recipes/curse_craft/$(), and can also be browsed in JEI (catalyst: Gheloth Ore).
